<thought>Search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates that break a trimethylsilyl group (the silicon‑carbon bond) and form a C‑C double bond, which corresponds to the Peterson elimination.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["trimethylsilyl"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
    "limit": 10
}
</action_input>
